run_circle_packing: run the circle packing constructor for 26 circles in a unit square and print the sum of radii
construct_circle_packing: construct an arrangement of 26 circles in a unit square using a center and ring pattern
compute_max_radii: compute the maximum non-overlapping radii for given circle centers constrained to a unit square
visualize_circle_packing: visualize a circle packing arrangement with labeled circles plotted in a unit square using matplotlib
refactor_construct_packing: refactor the construct_packing function to support a configurable number of circles instead of hardcoded 26
